page.layout: One page of text, all lines centred: title block at top, a woodcut engraving (palm tree with banner) in the middle, printer's imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: S. S. Literarum in Academia Groning-Omlandica Professoris,

page.notes: Woodcut between "ROMANOS." and "AMSTELÆDAMI,": a palm tree with a banner wound around its trunk. The upper banner words read "[?]T PALMA" (the first letters are cut off or obscured, probably "IVSTVS UT"). The lower banner reads "VIRESCIT". The imprint date is printed as cIↃ IↃC LXXXVI, transcribed as MDCLXXXVI. The handwritten shelf mark in pencil at the foot ("WB 171/285") is not printed and is left out.
